args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release.

trace.final:
Both actions completed successfully. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api and found v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback is verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, paging the on-call engineer, describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0.
